name: Basketball Challenge
author: Addicting Games
description: Basketball Challenge is a free mobile sports game.  Brace yourselves for an exhilarating clash of skills and physics in the ultimate basketball challenge! Get ready to dominate the court like never before in a free mobile or desktop game that will take your basketball prowess to cosmic heights. In this epic showdown, players worldwide compete in a gravity-defying spectacle where the laws of physics bend to your will. Your mission? To guide the ball into a floating and moving hoop by strategically mapping out its trajectory and launching it with the precision and finesse of a world-class sniper.  Basketball Challenge takes physics-based gameplay to a whole new level. Each hoop floats, rotates, and moves through space, adding a thrilling layer of challenge to every shot. You'll need razor-sharp precision, split-second timing, and a dash of cosmic luck to conquer these celestial hoops. Whether on the go or your desktop, "Basketball Challenge" offers seamless gameplay across platforms. You'll launch balls into orbit quickly with intuitive controls and engaging mechanics. Don't let gravity hold you back—take control of your destiny!
